County table: 133 rows, 48 positive; catchment table: 1,281 positive rows. Catchment omissions are not automatically controls. Tables record biosolids mass, not nitrogen. Daily field amounts were allocated over permitted areas before raster aggregation; exact application location within these areas is modeled. The original daily table is not included in this release. County `tons` versus catchment `lbs` requires unit reconciliation before combined analysis (see the accompanying manuscript evidence note).
